Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native RGBA transparent production sprite atlas for existing Chinese Water Margin isometric RTS.
Primary request: Draw FOUR independent full-body idle poses of Xu Ning, current foot spear hero, in a clean square 2 by 2 atlas on real transparent alpha. No horse.
Input images: Image 1 portraits2.png is identity authority ONLY BOTTOM-LEFT portrait: stern middle-aged Han Chinese man, tied black topknot with pale cloth tie, black moustache and pointed short beard, silver fish-scale armor, white scarf tied at chest and white cape, restrained warm gold trim. Image 2 units2.png THIRD ROW THIRD COLUMN is body/long hooked spear reference; adopt silver scale armor from portrait rather than its old golden armor. Image 3 xu_ning_attack.png is supporting white cape/silver-gold armor and single gold hooked spear shape reference; no red topknot ribbon.
Composition: Four equally sized cells. top-left facing southeast down-right; top-right southwest down-left; bottom-left northeast up-right with mostly back visible; bottom-right northwest up-left with mostly back visible. True oblique isometric 3/4 overhead camera about 30 degrees down, same camera and proportions in every cell. Feet toward ground below character, not flat side-view. Full figures including hair, cape, spear tip and butt within each cell with generous alpha gutters. Put feet near 85% cell height, body top near 20%. Spears diagonal close to body and not over neighboring cell. Hero body fills about 60% cell height.
Subject: SAME identity in all cells: bare topknot pale tie, NO helmet, silver fish-scale cuirass and layered skirt armor, warm dark-gold edges, dark forearm braces, silver greaves with brown leather boots, pale inner tunic, white chest scarf and shoulder cape hanging down back. ONE two-handed long dark wood shaft with gold spearhead and small hooked blade below tip, pale horsehair tuft below socket. Anatomical LEFT hand forward toward spearhead and RIGHT hand rear near waist; both physically wrap shaft with natural wrists. Mirroring the anatomy is forbidden: draw every facing independently. Back views show back of topknot, silver armor and white cape; face should not turn toward camera.
Style: refined hand-painted Northern Song historical fantasy game sprites, controlled fine ink outlines, muted parchment-warm accents on silver white steel, detailed material readable at game scale. No photorealism, no pixel art. Fixed soft warm upper-left light. Small natural grounding shadow only, no scenery/platform.
Constraints: exactly four separate single heroes, same scale each, idle relaxed grounded stance both feet planted, no effects, no text, no label, no border, no checkerboard painted into background, no watermarks, no extra weapons, no helmet, no red clothing, no horse. Preserve true transparent pixels and entire silhouette.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: ONE full-body standalone Xu Ning SOUTHWEST idle sprite on actual transparent background.

Image 2 is geometric ARM/GRIP AUTHORITY only; remove all diagram colors, text and shapes. Image 3 BOTTOM LEFT portrait is facial/costume authority.
Keep same middle-aged stern Chinese hero, black moustache/short pointed beard, bare topknot with pale tie, silver fish-scale armor/dark gold trim, white scarf/cape, brown boots. Foot hero NO horse. Same refined hand-painted game sprite style. True three-quarter isometric view from above.
Exact southwest geometry: face and torso toward lower-left. The anatomical LEFT arm starts at SCREEN RIGHT shoulder, bends inward across chest, and its hand grips shaft farther toward spear tip at SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Anatomical RIGHT arm starts at SCREEN LEFT shoulder, bends down then inward, gripping shaft near waist at SCREEN CENTER RIGHT, farther from tip. There must be TWO different hands on the same single straight shaft; shoulders and elbow routes must follow diagram. In final image the arm extending farther to lower-left is attached to SCREEN RIGHT shoulder. This is crucial; do not mirror the original atlas arms.
ONE dark wood long spear with gold spearhead and small hooked blade plus pale horsehair tuft. Spear tip at lower-left, butt up-right along diagonal across waist. Both hands clearly and naturally wrap shaft. Grounded idle, two feet planted, cape hangs behind hero with small natural drape. Keep entire weapon, head, hands, cape and feet visible, generous transparent margins. Body height ~65% square canvas, no clipping. No helmet, no red cloth, no diagram, no labels, no scenery, no extra character, no motion effects, no watermark.

Render the first reference's arm geometry into ONE refined hand-painted Chinese historical game sprite. True transparent RGBA background.

Leftward three-quarter face and torso, facing southwest down-left, overhead isometric camera. He stands idle with both feet grounded.
